title: Make AI-merica Great Again: Meme Lord Trump’s digital feed goes off rails again
summary_full: Donald Trump posted numerous AI-generated images on Truth Social over the weekend.  These images ranged from self-congratulatory to geopolitically consequential, causing confusion.  The posts included depictions of historical figures and geopolitical scenarios, raising alarm.  Critics worry about the distinction between memes and actual policy signals from the president.  Concerns about cognitive decline and national security implications are being voiced by analysts.
